elements.label: Evidence of Distinction Dials
elements.description: Using the SDMo distinctions, identify the elements of the conversation as they appear by marking the knobs below. Distinctions are available in the other page
control_low_descriptions: General topics about medical conditions and options. "for patients like you".
Relatively linear and straightforward. Series of chores to be completed during the conversation. Exchange of turns, information, opinions, questions, preferences, etc. Work to complete the ecounter.
control_high_descriptions: Motivated by something that needs to change and barriers to changing it. Usually highly patient specific and pertinent.

Patients and clinicians working together methodically to improve the situation. Resolution of improvement of situational tensions. Decisions are the culmination of trying out and working through. Method of inquiry.

elements.label: Did the identified inquiry items relate to one another in a way that constitutes a method of inquiry?
SDM Occurrence
elements.description: Using your annotations, answer the following question: Did Shared Decision Making occur in this conversation? Please choose a number below.

tags.label: Noticing
tags.description: Acts that support the identification of a situation that is potentially problematic.

tags.label: Take Notice
tags.description: Participants respond to something odd, troubling, or promising

tags.label: Commit
tags.description: Participants show a shared interest in changing a problematic situation

tags.label: Formulating
tags.description: Acts that support the exploration of the nature of the situation, what makes it problematic, and what can potentially be done in response by identifying particularly pertinent aspects.

tags.label: Focus
tags.description: Participants seek out the issues that characterize the problematic situation and what to try to change about it

tags.label: Create Ideas
tags.description: The conversation produces ideas for potential ways to change the problematic situation

tags.label: Flesh Out Ideas
tags.description: Participants seek out pertinent issues that may make a potential change desirable or undesirable

tags.label: Trying Out
tags.description: Acts that support the development of potential actions to take in response to the situation through the relating and valuing of formulations. The ways in which formulations are translated into meaning or action.

tags.label: Try Out Ideas
tags.description: Participants envision and evaluate how the patient's life would be if a potential change is made

tags.label: Learn from Trying Out
tags.description: Trying out potential changes produces a better understanding of the situation

tags.label: Iterate
tags.description: By trying out potential changes, participants accept, refine, discard, or create potential ways to change the problematic situation

tags.label: Reflect
tags.description: The conversation clarifies the reasons that participants have for accepting, refining, discarding, or creating potential ways to change the problematic situation

tags.label: Culminating
tags.description: The process of arriving at a carefully considered, shared conclusion about how to address a problematic situation, one that is meaningful and makes sense intellectually, practically, and emotionally.

tags.label: Form Thoughtful Conclusion
tags.description: The conversation leads to a thoughtful conclusion about the action to be taken

tags.label: Tying Together Intellectually
tags.description: Reaching a conclusion includes confirming that the action is understood, logical, and desired by all participants

tags.label: Tying Together Practically
tags.description: Reaching a conclusion includes resolving barriers to implementing the action

tags.label: Tying Together Emotionally
tags.description: Reaching a conclusion includes responding to the participants' emotional needs

tags.label: Make an Agreement
tags.description: Participants agree to commence the course of action

tags.label: Find Worthwhile
tags.description: Participants express that what they have achieved in the conversation is valuable

tags.label: Enabling Actions
tags.description: Signs that the process of inquiry was shared among the participants.

tags.label: Displaying Curiosity
tags.description: Participants are curious

tags.label: Strengthening Partnership
tags.description: Participants foster their ability to work together

tags.label: Creating Space
tags.description: The conversation creates opportunities for important issues to surface

tags.label: Tailoring Information
tags.description: Participants tailor information to be pertinent, useful, and usable for other participants

tags.label: Drawing on Experience
tags.description: The conversation draws on participants' prior experience with trying to change the situation
